mcqs.question: What approach did the Jammu and Kashmir Government propose for the conservation of Dal Lake after cancelling the ₹416.72 crore restoration plan?
options: In-situ conservation, allowing residents to remain in place
Continuation of the cancelled ₹416.72 crore restoration plan
Conservation of the lake as a 60-acre man-made water body
mcqs.explanation: The proposed approach for Dal Lake was in-situ conservation, under which residents would remain in place. The ₹416.72 crore restoration plan had been cancelled, so its continuation is incorrect.
